t: How much of it is down here
a: جَعَلَ اللَّهُ الرَّحْمَةَ مِائَةَ جُزْءٍ، فَأَمْسَكَ عِنْدَهُ تِسْعَةً وَتِسْعِينَ جُزْءًا، وَأَنْزَلَ فِي الأَرْضِ جُزْءًا وَاحِدًا، فَمِنْ ذَلِكَ الْجُزْءِ يَتَرَاحَمُ الْخَلْقُ
p: Jaʿala-Llāhu-r-raḥmata miʾata juzʾ, fa-amsaka ʿindahu tisʿatan wa tisʿīna juzʾan, wa anzala fi-l-arḍi juzʾan wāḥidā, fa-min dhālika-l-juzʾi yatarāḥamu-l-khalq
m: Allah made mercy a hundred parts. He kept ninety nine with Him and sent down one part to the earth. From that one part the creation shows mercy to one another.
